## Agents

No gate delegate. The gate owner is the lead.

## Product Owner

The backlog is the file backlog.md beside this file. Keep the open questions in the file questions.md beside the backlog.

## Product Manager

The person who decides is the squad's Product Manager. The evidence sources are metrics.csv, a weekly export from the analytics tool, and research-notes.md, the notes of five user interviews. The team has no strategy document.
